notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
[h1]Tank Zombie[/h1]

Hello, survivors!
Today, we would like to introduce you to the Tank Zombie in The Midnight Walkers.
In this development log, we will delve into the design process and characteristics of the Tank Zombie.

[h2][Design Overview][/h2]
The Tank Zombie boasts formidable HP, unlike typical zombies.
These zombies possess immense strength due to their past involvement in athletic activities before infection.

[h2][Appearance Design][/h2]
The design of the Tank Zombie is very unique.
Please refer to the descriptions and images below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/55cf5d5d9025394dc0806e71192be0b520427098.png[/img]

[h3]Facial Scar Reference[/h3] The Tank Zombie’s face shows significant damage due to infection and abrasions, representing the severity of the infection and simultaneously displaying their pain and anger.

[h3]Exposed Infection Symptoms[/h3] Parts of the body show skin peeled away due to the virus, revealing blisters underneath.
These blisters visually demonstrate the advanced stages of the infection.
This will immediately instill fear in the survivors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/8056c5711c7179fbaf026c9840e96c45e20cd02f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/7ee33b8b3790cc012902598fbc7c30894fb3acb1.png[/img]

[h3]Skin Texture[/h3] The skin is lumpy and covered with scars, realistically depicting the decaying process caused by the infection. These details enhance the terror of the zombie.

[h3]Clothing[/h3] The Tank Zombie wears gym uniforms or workout clothes. This reflects their pre-infection life and tells the story of the zombie to the players.

[h3]Modeling[/h3] This zombie's modeling was created using high-resolution textures and meticulous modeling techniques. The muscle details, skin texture, and scars were enhanced by referencing the bodies of real athletes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/e8aaddc369480b198fbeb8a6d2514c1f103b9f9c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/d075afca687bbefc964c93a3d7010f0833e89c1a.png[/img]

[h2][In-game][/h2]
The Tank Zombie poses a significant threat to survivors due to its powerful HP and strength.
Their main roles and characteristics are as follows:

[h3]High HP[/h3] The Tank Zombie has much more HP than other zombies, making it difficult to take down. This means survivors need to approach them more strategically.

[h3]Powerful Attack[/h3] They deliver slow but very powerful attacks that can cause significant damage in a single blow. They are especially threatening in close combat.

[h2][Dev Process][/h2]
Our development team conducted numerous tests to develop the Tank Zombie.
We meticulously adjusted not only the zombie's appearance but also its movements and behavior patterns.

[h3]Animation[/h3] The movements and attack animations were enhanced by referencing the movements of real athletes. Specifically, the zombie's slow and heavy gait and powerful attack motions were created using motion capture technology.

[h3]AI Patterns[/h3] The AI of the Tank Zombie reacts to the player's movements.
When the player is nearby, it relentlessly pursues them slowly and delivers powerful melee attacks when close.
Do not be complacent when the Tank Zombie is looking down.
When attacking a Tank Zombie that is looking down, it does not rise slowly and can deliver a fatal blow to the survivor with its well-trained body.

[h3]Testing[/h3] We have conducted various tests to balance the game and maximize the horror experience for survivors. We plan to continuously adjust and improve the zombie's attack power, HP, and behavior patterns based on your feedback, so please provide us with your valuable opinions.

Below is an animation video of the Tank Zombie under development.

[previewyoutube=Ah0qoUj1DU4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][Future Plans][/h2]
Our development team is polishing not only the Tank Zombie but also various other zombies.
We plan to provide even more diverse experiences by reflecting the feedback from survivors.
Along with new mutant zombies, we will continuously improve the abilities and behavior patterns of existing zombies.

Thank you!

Welcome to the first dev log of "The Midnight Walkers." This time, we're introducing the Escape Pod Tracker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/bbde4a0e803049285788b5f21b1a45d4067e80a7.png[/img][b]Escape Pod Tracker Concept Art[/b]

This device is the only means to survive in Liberty Grand Center, allowing you to track escape pods. If you don't want to use an activated escape pod immediately, you can extract and store the escape code from the activated escape pod. Stored escape codes can be used to activate inactive escape pods.

[h2]Device Design and Functionality[/h2]
The Escape Pod Tracker features a retro design reminiscent of classic handheld gaming devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905381/d68f96a4def695a2e7dd888b4bb063263b21d0eb.png[/img][b]Escape Pod Tracker Modeling Image[/b]

[b][h3][Visual Design][/h3][/b]
This device has a compact, handheld design with a digital screen that displays crucial information. The unique antenna and tape-fixed battery case give it a rugged, makeshift feel, enhancing the game's apocalyptic atmosphere.

[b][h3][Display and Interface][/h3][/b]
The use of tape and anchoring clips for securing components reflects the urgency and resourcefulness in an apocalyptic setting. The UI is simple yet functional, featuring a radar-style interface that easily visualizes nearby escape pods.

[b][h3][In-Game Functionality][/h3][/b]
The main display shows the number of nearby escape pods and the distance based on your location. The circular meter darkens as you approach an escape pod. As mentioned earlier, you can extract and store the escape code from activated escape pods. These stored codes can then be used to activate other inactive escape points. This feature allows you to strategically use escape routes, enhancing your chances of survival during crises or when obtaining high-tier items.

[b][h3][References][/h3][/b]
The design draws inspiration from classic handheld devices, merging nostalgic charm with modern gameplay mechanics. The layout and button configuration, inspired by the Game Boy, brings vintage appeal to the gameplay experience.

- Howler will be added. This attracts other zombies and immobilizes survivors with its screams.
- Boss zombie will appear in the hidden area of the new underground parking lot. (Need a security card to access this area)
- Runner and Walker zombies will be redesigned.

[b][h2]#2 Map and Level Design[/h2][/b]
[h3]Addition of New Concept Maps (Floors)[/h3]
- New maps, such as the Lounge Club and Underground Parking Lot, will be added.
- In-progress Shopping Mall map will also be completed.

[h3]Level Design and Distinct Atmosphere[/h3]
- Each floor will have a distinct theme with unique lighting and ambiance.
- Hidden farming points and unique loot specific to each floor's concept.

[b][h2]#3 Enhanced Farming Experience[/h2][/b]
[h3]Various Farming Boxes[/h3]
- Add a variety of boxes that fit the apocalypse setting, such as toolboxes, weapon boxes, military boxes, and body bags.

[h3]Farming System[/h3]
- Reduce the interaction time with boxes and add item appraisal times.
- Circular icons will appear when interactable boxes or items are nearby, making them easier to spot.
- The background of item icons in the inventory will reflect their rarity.

[b][h2]#4 Escape System[/h2][/b]
[h3]Extraction System for Escape Pods[/h3]
- When an escape pod appears, you can extract a [Power Cartridge] from it, allowing you to activate a deactivated escape pod and escape at any time.
- Use the extracted [Power Cartridge] on a deactivated escape pod to escape with your squad members immediately.

[h3]Public Escape Elevator[/h3]
- Hidden emergency escape elevator that can accommodate up to three people will be added.
- Essential items will be required to activate it.

[h3]Container System[/h3]
- Even if you can't escape, the container will secure your important items.

[b][h2]#5 New Weapons and Equipment[/h2][/b]
[h3]Character Appearance Changes[/h3]
- Your character's appearance will now change based on the armor equipped on each part, allowing you to gauge the level of your opponent's armor during encounters.

[h3]New Weapons[/h3]
- New weapons such as the trash spear and dagger will be added.
- Throwable weapons like Molotov cocktails and additional trap items will be added.
- Class-specific weapons will be more detailed.

[h3]Advanced Balancing of Weapons[/h3]
- Rebalance existing weapons in addition to introducing new ones.
- Fix issues where ranged weapons dealt abnormal damage and adjust the overall balance.

[b][h2]#6 New Class and Balance Updates[/h2][/b]
[h3]New Class: [Bartender][/h3]
- Bartender who makes special drinks using folk remedies and secret recipes will be introduced.
- The special drinks made with the bartender's secret recipes in their exclusive flask will empower squads and inflict pain on enemies.

[h3]Renewal and Advanced Balancing of Existing Classes[/h3]
- The Technician will be renamed.
- Various active skills and perks will be added to all classes.
- Minimize unreasonable gameplay experiences by rebalancing the overall PVE and PVP balance.

[b][h2]#7 Out Game Content[/h2][/b]
[h3]Marketplace System[/h3]
- Survivors will be able to sell and purchase various equipment and material items through the marketplace.

[h3]Crafting System[/h3]
- The existing crafting system will be improved to become a crafting workshop.
- More diverse equipment and items can be created by collecting unique materials.

[b][h2]#8 Matchmaking Rule Updates[/h2][/b]
[h3]Improved Solo and Duo/Trio Matching[/h3]
- Solo and duo/trio matchmaking will be separated, but solo players can join duo/trio matches.
- Solo matches will start with fewer players, and the floor range will be smaller accordingly.
    - Example: Duo/Trio matches use 10 floors, while solo matches use 5-7 floors (TBD).

[b][h2]#9 General Gameplay Experience[/h2][/b]
[h3]Sound Play Experience[/h3]
- Fine-tune all elements sound balancing and spatial awareness to enable more detailed sound play.

[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
- Minimize unnecessary operations and redesign the UX for intuitive controls.
- UI improvements will also be made alongside the UX enhancements.

[h3] Bullet Removal Feature[/h3]
- Removal of bullets from loaded guns.

These are the main updates we have prepared. There are also various other improvements not listed here.
We cannot share the exact schedule for the next test yet, as our dev team is still finalizing the dev schedule.
However, we will strive to plan the next test as soon as possible and continue to communicate with you about new content and improvements throughout the dev process.

notes.title: Pre-alpha testing ended
notes.notes:
Hello. Survivors.

I'm Ray, Director of Development for The Midnight Walkers. 
I'd like to start by saying a big thank you to all the players who participated in our first pre-alpha test. 

We're still in the early stages of development, so there's a lot of things that are still missing, but the fact that you've had so much fun with the game in such a short amount of time has been very encouraging to our development team. So thank you. 

We've gotten a lot of hints from this test to make a more complete game. 
We also realized our shortcomings, and it was a valuable time for us to get a clearer sense of what direction we need to develop in. 

This test was intended to validate the basic game mechanics of The Midnight Walkers, which we developed from August last year to April this year, and as our first field test, it was conducted from the perspective of a technical test to check for technical defects and improve stability. 

Therefore, we are truly sorry and grateful for the unfriendly gaming experience, unreasonable balance, frequent errors and checks, and the loss of your valuable time. 

Despite the interruption during the previous test period due to an AWS account blocking issue that occurred in the early morning hours of the first day, we were really impressed that you were able to stick around for two more weeks, and that you enjoyed the playtest once again. Your feedback and bug reports helped us to identify various issues that we didn't see during the development process.

All of the feedback and bug reports collected during the test period will be reviewed by the development team. 

We'd also like to say a huge thank you to the many streamers who continued to play and stream, even if it was only for a short time, even though many of their favorite titles were released and available to play. 

All of our developers watched every single one of the channels and content you streamed and had a good laugh while monitoring them during the testing period. 

While this test validated the basic game mechanics and performed technical tests, the next test will bring a lot of polish, new additions, and expanded volume so that you can experience the unique gameplay of The Midnight Walkers in its entirety.

Despite our unresponsiveness and shortcomings during the test period, we'd like to thank you for sticking with us. 

We're now hard at work on the next phase of development, and we'll continue to communicate with you as diligently as we have been. 

It's been an honor to share our first pre-alpha beta with you! 
Keep up the great work and support, and we hope to see you at the next test. 

Thank you.

Oneway Ticket Studio Dev Team and Ray.
